medium.reason: Explicit reference Newtonian liquid, externally isothermal, single phase and constant density. rho and mu are declared constitutive data, not an inferred substance package. No energy or equilibrium certification is claimed.

workspaceNotes.model: Two prismatic free-surface volumes exchange the same liquid through one circular path. Matter starts from local conservation; momentum starts from Cauchy. Reservoir pressure is deduced from hydrostatic force compatibility, surface conditions and inventory-derived height. No pressure-difference trajectory or equilibrium level is imposed.
workspaceNotes.transform: Identity formulation. These are lumped models: no spatial mesh is selected. The displayed assumptions and geometry remain attached to Solve.
workspaceNotes.solve: Integrate both mass inventories and the shared flow. Surface pressures are boundary conditions; port pressures and their difference follow from the changing inventories. Start with zero flow while the unequal inventories drive a nonzero acceleration.
workspaceNotes.results: Inspect pressure, flow and conservation checks. This is an assumed-medium, isothermal hydraulic approximation with quasi-steady laminar wall resistance, not an exact spatial transient Navier–Stokes or thermodynamic certification.
